# Turbo

`turbo.js` is the unmodified `dist/turbo.es2017-esm.js` from `@hotwired/turbo` 8.0.23, licensed under MIT; see `TURBO-LICENSE.md`. It is loaded only for the experimental Hotwire Native user agent and cached locally for offline use. Turbo Drive is disabled because this is a single-page application with its own form and fragment routing.

The CSP permits the SHA-256 hash of Turbo 8.0.23's injected progress-bar stylesheet only, not arbitrary inline styles. Recheck the hash when upgrading Turbo.
